title: quasiSteady operation
description: The quasi-steady adapter of choupoCtrl / choupoSemiContinuous: a STEADY unit wrapped so that it is solved to steady state on its inlets at every accepted instant, holding no inventory of its own. It has NO `operation` block: the wrapped unit's whole declaration is the `unit { type <steadyType>; ... }` sub-block (its own keys, never `in`, `inputs`, `outputs` or `name`, and never another quasiSteady), and the t = 0 inlet states are `inlets { <stream> { F; T; P; composition } }`, one per declared inlet stream; topology (`in` or `inputs`, `outputs`) stays on the unit itself (QuasiSteadyUnit.cpp:55-115). This schema is empty on purpose: the wrapped unit's keys are described by THAT unit's own schema.
